title: Infrastructure & Services
description: Manage Docker-hosted core database, cache, optional extraction/OCR sidecars, logical backups, config.json infrastructure settings, and Danger Zone recovery.
superAdminOnly: Only superadmins can manage host infrastructure and Docker services.

overview.composeEmpty: No docker-compose.yml generated yet (automatically written when managed services run).

services.coreDesc: PostgreSQL + pgvector and Redis bind only to 127.0.0.1 with host bind mounts; core services cannot be stopped or deleted from the UI.
services.optionalDesc: Pull prebuilt GHCR images with one click; endpoints are automatically wired into File Extraction settings and synced to docker-compose.yml.

backups.title: PostgreSQL Logical Backups
backups.description: Streams pg_dump -Fc through gzip with SHA-256 verification into the host backups directory, supporting scheduled rotation and downloads.
backups.deleteConfirm: Delete only backup file {name}? (Does not touch live database or pgdata directory.)

config.title: Infrastructure Configuration (config.json)
config.description: Safely edit common infrastructure settings; jwt_secret and data_encryption_key cannot be modified here. Restart smoothly to apply all changes.
config.s3SecretKey: S3 Secret Access Key (leave blank to keep unchanged)
config.restartingBanner: In-place smooth restart triggered; waiting for FireCortex to reconnect...

danger.title: Danger Zone
danger.description: All high-risk actions require current superadmin password + explicit confirmation text and are recorded in audit logs. Host pgdata directories are never deleted from the UI.

restore.title: Restore PostgreSQL from Backup
restore.description: Verifies SHA-256, automatically captures a pre-restore safety snapshot of the live DB, runs pg_restore, and performs a smooth restart.

switchDb.title: Switch Database & Cache Mode (Managed ↔ External)
switchDb.description: Tests target connectivity before updating config.json; previous data directories and containers are preserved untouched.

recreate.title: Force Recreate Core Container (Preserve Data)
recreate.description: Pulls the configured image and recreates the container while strictly keeping the host data directory; PostgreSQL captures a pre-upgrade snapshot first.
